scripts.deploy:production: bun run deploy && bun run verify:production
scripts.verify:production: node node_modules/playwright/cli.js install chromium && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/verify-production.mts
scripts.a11y:smoke: node node_modules/playwright/cli.js install chromium && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/a11y-smoke.mts
scripts.auth:generate: bunx sst shell --stage local -- bun run --filter @repo/auth auth:generate
scripts.db:generate: bunx sst shell --stage local -- bun run --filter @repo/db db:generate
scripts.db:migrate: bunx sst shell --stage local -- bun run --filter @repo/db db:migrate
scripts.db:push: bunx sst shell --stage local -- bun run --filter @repo/db db:push
scripts.db:studio: bunx sst shell --stage local -- bun run --filter @repo/db db:studio
